sections.text:
test: fix reorg_metrics_placement under real testnet PoW (#41×#42 merge greened main red)
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/45

PR #41 (reorg metrics) and #42 (persistent testnet) each passed CI alone, but merged together they turn main's `test (testnet)` lane red — a semantic conflict neither PR's isolated CI could catch.

`tests/reorg_metrics_placement.rs` built blocks with `nonce: 0` at `genesis_target()`. Under the old trivial `0xFF` testnet target nonce 0 always satisfied PoW; #42 made the testnet target a real `2^252`, so nonce 0 now fails (`PowFailed`) and the hand-built blocks are rejected — both tests fail at `process_block(...).expect("a1 accepted")`.

## Change (test-only)

- Add a `mine` helper that grinds `nonce` until the header satisfies `verify_pow` (~16 Argon2id attempts at the 2^252 target), and call it from `build_block` after the header fields are final.
- The corrupted-state_root fork block is re-mined after the corruption so it still passes header/PoW validation and is `Stored` as a fork candidate; the state_root mismatch is still only caught at reorg-apply, so the test's intent is preserved.

No production code changes. Both tests pass under the testnet lane again; the default lane is unaffected.
